Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

RedKinNet 0.1.0

First release.

  • rkn_graph_from_kinship() builds the network of related samples from a kinship matrix or a table of pairs, with thresholds given as numbers or as KING degrees of relationship.
  • rkn_check_samples() flags possible duplicates, contaminated samples and samples of different ancestry.
  • rkn_select_random() selects a largest set of unrelated individuals uniformly at random among all of them, with exact inclusion probabilities, or, with uniform = FALSE, by structural rules.
  • rkn_select_criteria() chooses among the largest sets by preferences for individuals (rkn_criterion_cutoff(), rkn_criterion_level()), within the choices left by the rules or, with optimal = TRUE, over all the largest sets of each family.
  • rkn_select_global() reaches a target proportion or mean of a covariate over the whole selection exactly, optionally giving up individuals (max_loss); rkn_tradeoff() shows the composition reachable for each number of individuals given up.
  • Selections are objects of class rkn_selection with print(), summary() and plot() methods; rkn_plot_pre() draws a network before the selection.
  • rkn_example is a synthetic cohort for the examples and the three vignettes.

Developed by Paolo Dalena.
